title: Power Query: transform, merge, append and unpivot

videos.script: Lesson 13 brought the data in. Three months of web orders, a courier's invoice, and the tables you already had. None of it is ready to use. {{raw}} Two orders were cancelled. Two product codes are in lower case. And the columns have the platform's names, not yours. {{mess}} This lesson fixes that one step at a time. Each fix is a step, and every step runs again next month. {{steps}} Then it joins things. A merge looks up the cost of every order in the products table. And it shows what happens when the key on the other side is not unique. One order, counted twice, with no error. {{merge}} An append puts the web orders under the sales you already had, if the column names agree. {{append}} Then the budget. Twelve months across the top, the way people write budgets. One command turns it into one row per month. {{unpivot}} Group By adds it up. And for the first time, the plan sits beside what was actually sold. {{group}} Last, the list of steps itself. Why the order changes the answer. And what the error means when a source renames a column. {{code}}
